Which of the following is/are true regarding an SVM?
Option A: For two dimensional data points, the separating hyperplane learnt by a linear SVM will be a straight line.
Option B: In theory, a Gaussian kernel SVM cannot model any complex separating hyperplane.
Option C: For every kernel function used in a SVM, one can obtain an equivalent closed form basis expansion.
Option D: Overfitting in an SVM is not a function of number of support vectors.
